data.narrative:
Primoco UAV is a public-stage defense and security company founded by Ladislav Semetkovský. The valuation universe spans 26 same-sector peers, consisting of 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private-stage firms including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Peer-median analysis is not applicable to this valuation. The Defense & Security sector yields an insufficient narrow peer set when filtered by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier. Only 1 same-stage peer was identified, with 0 adjacent-stage and 0 similar-tier comparables meeting inclusion thresholds. The methodology requires a minimum of 3 datapoints to establish statistical reliability; a fall-back to all-sector median would conflate fundamentally different business models and scales, introducing unacceptable distortion.

Without a sufficiently robust comparable set, this analysis cannot support a triangulated valuation range. The available 2 public tickers and 5 named private peers remain too sparse and heterogeneous to anchor a defensible price target. A complete valuation would require either (1) expansion of the comp universe through adjacent defense-tech subsectors with documented stage and scale alignment, (2) deployment of alternative methods such as DCF or transaction-based multiples if forward guidance or M&A precedent exists, or (3) accumulation of additional same-stage, same-tier private data. The orderbook of €44M+ represents deployed capital but does not independently establish fair value without revenue-multiple or margin context.
